steps.summary: Hug cliff/river edge North-East straight to The Forest Encampment
steps.layout_tell: Linear forest corridor: keep heading North-East along the main gap in the trees.
steps.portal_tip: No quests here — run straight into Act 2 Town

actions.text: Run NE through the trees — ignore monkeys
Tag WP at end & enter The Forest Encampment

variants.title: Linear Corridor
variants.desc: Always starts SW and exits NE into Forest Encampment.

steps.summary: Act 2 Town Hub (3 Exits) → Take the North-East (NE) exit first into The Old Fields (West exit to The Riverways is used later)
steps.layout_tell: The Forest Encampment has 3 exits: SE = The Southern Forest (where you came from), NE (top-right past Greust) = The Old Fields (GO HERE FIRST), and West (left across wooden bridge) = The Riverways (take this later after Chamber of Sins Level 2).
steps.next_exit: Take NE Exit (top-right) → Enter The Old Fields
steps.portal_tip: Go NE to The Old Fields first; use the West exit to The Riverways later after Chamber of Sins Level 2

actions.text: Check Yeena & Greust for 3-links / movement boots
1st Route (Now): Exit North-East (top-right past Greust) into The Old Fields
2nd Route (After Chamber of Sins 2): Exit West across the bridge into The Riverways

steps.boss_info: Safe Town Hub (Eramir, Yeena, Greust, Silk, Helena).
steps.gem_reward: Yeena sells Lvl 8 & Lvl 12 Skill/Support Gems; completing Chamber of Sins 2 unlocks Lvl 16 Heralds.

variants.title: 3-Exit Town Hub
variants.desc: SE = Southern Forest (entry), NE = The Old Fields (1st exit), W = The Riverways (2nd exit after Fidelitas).

steps.summary: Follow the cobblestone road NE → Optional: Drop Portal at The Den → Enter The Crossroads
steps.layout_tell: The cobblestone road ALWAYS leads directly from Forest Encampment to The Crossroads exit!
steps.portal_tip: Skip The Den unless you want a 2nd Quicksilver Flask

actions.text: Stay on the cobblestone road heading North-East
(Optional) Drop portal at The Den entrance if you want 2nd Quicksilver
Follow road into The Crossroads

steps.boss_info: The Great White Beast (inside The Den): Optional quest for 2nd Quicksilver Flask.
steps.gem_reward: The Great White Beast (Yeena): Quicksilver Flask or Silver Flask.

variants.title: Road-Guided Field
variants.desc: Never leave the stone road unless looking for The Den.

topology.procedural_note: Road always leads NE to Crossroads; The Den entrance spawns randomly off-road

steps.summary: Follow road to Waypoint at center fork → Go North-West to Chamber of Sins Level 1
steps.layout_tell: At the central Waypoint fork: NW = Chamber of Sins, NE = Broken Bridge (Kraityn), SE = Fellshrine Ruins (Lab Trial).
steps.next_exit: Tag WP → Take NW Fork → Chamber of Sins Level 1
steps.portal_tip: Tag The Crossroads Waypoint — you will use it 3 times in Act 2!

actions.text: Follow road to the central Waypoint & tag it!
Take the North-West fork (uphill dirt path)
Enter The Chamber of Sins Level 1

steps.boss_info: Calaf, Headstaver (near gate): Easy to run past.
steps.gem_reward: Hub zone connecting Chamber of Sins (Lvl 16 Herald/Blood Rage gems), Kraityn, and Crypt Trial.

variants.title: 3-Fork Hub
variants.desc: WP sits at the intersection: NW = Sins, NE = Bridge, SE = Fellshrine.

steps.summary: Reach center Map Device room → Level 2 is ALWAYS down whichever of the 3 hallways (NW/NE/SE) the Map Device points toward!
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ 4-WAY CROSS TELL: In the center Waypoint room, look at which hallway (NW, NE, or SE) the broken carpet & Map Device point toward — Level 2 is 100% down that hallway!
steps.next_exit: Follow Map Device direction → Enter Chamber of Sins Level 2
steps.portal_tip: Tag Waypoint in center room just in case

actions.text: Run to the central circular room with the Waypoint & Map Device
Take the hallway matching the Map Device's orientation
Descend stairs into The Chamber of Sins Level 2

steps.boss_info: Black Death (Unique Necromancer): Summons skeletons; ignore and take stairs.
steps.gem_reward: Completing Level 2 next unlocks Level 16 Herald & Aura Gems!

variants.title: Diamond Cross Layout
variants.desc: 4 hallways radiating from center WP; Map Device points to the exit hallway.

topology.procedural_note: 3 seed exits (NW, NE, or SE): Follow whichever hallway the center Map Device points toward

steps.summary: Complete Lab Trial #2 → Follow long narrow corridor → Kill Fidelitas & take Baleful Gem
steps.layout_tell: Fidelitas is always at the end of a long narrow diagonal hallway in the North-West or North-East.
steps.next_exit: Kill Fidelitas → Loot Baleful Gem → Relog to Town (Helena)
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after grabbing the Baleful Gem & talking to Helena!

actions.text: Complete Trial of Ascendancy (Spinning Sawblades)
Find narrow corridor → Kill Fidelitas & click Strange Device
Pick up Baleful Gem → Logout to Town → Talk to Greust & Helena

steps.boss_info: Fidelitas, the Mourning: Pure Lightning melee & Lightning Strike projectiles. Topaz Ring helps!
steps.gem_reward: Intruders in Black (Greust/Yeena): Unlocks Lvl 16 Herald Gems (Herald of Ash, Ice, Thunder, Purity, Agony, Blood Rage, Desecrate, Wave of Conviction).

variants.title: NW Boss / NE Trial
variants.desc: Look for the long thin bridge corridor leading to Fidelitas's arena.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural dungeon: Trial #2 & Fidelitas's long narrow corridor spawn in varying quadrants

steps.summary: Enter from Town (East/NE) → Follow cobblestone road SW to Waypoint & Western Forest (NW pillars lead to Wetlands)
steps.layout_tell: You enter from The Forest Encampment at the East/North-East and follow the cobblestone road South-West (SW) to The Western Forest. Near the Waypoint, two mossy stone pillars mark the dirt path North-West (NW) to The Wetlands!
steps.next_exit: Tag WP → Follow road into The Western Forest
steps.portal_tip: Tag The Riverways Waypoint so you can come back for Oak in The Wetlands!

actions.text: Follow main cobblestone road to the Waypoint & tag it
Stay on the cobblestone road past the broken bridge (use movement skill)
Enter The Western Forest at the end of the road

steps.boss_info: No required boss in The Riverways.
steps.gem_reward: Leads to Western Forest (3 quests in 1 zone!).

variants.title: Road Spine
variants.desc: Main road cuts straight across; Wetlands entrance is North of the WP.

steps.summary: Follow Road SW to WP → Torch on Road points to Alira → Opposite side is Weaver's Chambers → Arteri at SW end (+1 Pt)
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ TORCH TELL: Follow the central road SW. Near the WP, a Torch & broken cobbles on the road edge ALWAYS point toward Alira's camp (can spawn on NW or SE side)! The Weaver's Chambers is always on the OPPOSITE side of the road.
steps.next_exit: Do Weaver's Chambers + Alira + Captain Arteri (+1 Skill Pt!)
steps.portal_tip: After Captain Arteri & Thaumetic Seal, talk to Bestel in Act 1 Town for +1 Passive Skill Point!

actions.text: Follow road to Waypoint & spot the Torch side-path (Alira's side)
Opposite side of road from Alira → Enter Weaver's Chambers & kill Weaver
Follow road to far SW end → Kill Captain Arteri & click Thaumetic Seal (+1 Pt)

steps.boss_info: Alira: Casts Detonate Dead on corpses (do not stand on corpses!). Captain Arteri: Heavy Physical + Bleed.
steps.gem_reward: Sharp and Cruel (Silk): Lvl 18 Support Gems! The Way Forward (Bestel in Act 1): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Point)!

variants.title: Alira West / Weaver East
variants.desc: Torch is on the left of the road; Weaver's web trees are on the right.

variants.title: Alira East / Weaver West
variants.desc: Torch is on the right of the road; Weaver's web trees are on the left.

topology.procedural_note: 2 seed variants: Alira (Torch side) & Weaver's Chambers (Opposite side) swap between NW and SE of the road

steps.summary: Navigate web-covered cave tunnels → Enter The Weaver's Nest → Kill The Weaver & take Maligaro's Spike
steps.layout_tell: Procedural spider dungeon with no fixed compass direction: follow the thickest spider-webbing and avoid short dead-end side alcoves until you reach The Weaver's Nest door.
steps.next_exit: Kill The Weaver → Loot Maligaro's Spike → Portal/Logout back to Western Forest or Town (Silk)
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after looting Maligaro's Spike (or take portal if continuing Western Forest)

actions.text: Navigate spider tunnels toward denser web curtains
Enter The Weaver's Nest → Kill The Weaver & loot Maligaro's Spike
Return to Western Forest (or Town to claim Lvl 18 Support Gem from Silk)

steps.boss_info: The Weaver: Chaos & Physical Ethereal Knives + Viper Strike. Retreats to ceiling at 50% HP to spawn spiders.
steps.gem_reward: Sharp and Cruel (Silk): Unlocks Level 18 Support Gems (Controlled Destruction, Elemental Focus, Faster Attacks, Concentrated Effect, Vicious Projectiles, Cruelty).

variants.title: Procedural Web Cavern
variants.desc: Layout varies heavily by seed; follow thicker webbing toward The Weaver's Nest.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural cave: Insufficient fixed layout data — follow denser spider webs to Boss

steps.summary: Take Crossroads WP → Go NE to Broken Bridge → Follow road to Kill Kraityn
steps.layout_tell: Follow the cobblestone road North-East straight to Kraityn's broken bridge camp.
steps.next_exit: Kill Kraityn (or Help) → Loot Kraityn's Amulet → Logout to Town

actions.text: Follow the broken cobblestone road North-East
Kill Kraityn at the bridge gap & loot Kraityn's Amulet
Logout to Town → Take WP to Crossroads (SE for Crypt Trial) or Riverways

steps.boss_info: Kraityn: Uses Flicker Strike & Whirling Blades (Bleed + Physical).
steps.gem_reward: Part of Deal with the Bandits (+1 Passive Skill Point when killing all 3).

variants.title: Road to Bridge
variants.desc: Road leads directly from entrance to Kraityn's camp.

steps.summary: (Optional Now or Later) From Crossroads WP go SE through Fellshrine → Complete Lab Trial #3
steps.layout_tell: Follow the road SE through Fellshrine Ruins into The Crypt; hug outer walls to spot the Trial icon.
steps.next_exit: Complete Trial of Ascendancy (Spinning Blades/Discs) → Relog to Town
steps.portal_tip: Can be skipped and run anytime later via The Crossroads Waypoint!

actions.text: From Crossroads WP, run SE along Fellshrine road into The Crypt
Tag WP & complete Trial of Ascendancy (Normal Trial 3/6)
Logout to Town → Take WP to The Riverways

steps.boss_info: Risen Dead & Necromancers: Curses and Chaos poison clouds on death.

variants.title: Four-Corner Grid
variants.desc: Trial spawns in one of the far corners away from entrance.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural 4-corner loop: Hug outer perimeter walls to locate Lab Trial #3

steps.summary: From Riverways WP go North → Kill Oak in center camp → Poison Tree Roots NW → Enter Vaal Ruins
steps.layout_tell: Oak's bandit camp is ALWAYS in the exact center of The Wetlands; the Waypoint & Tree Roots are along the NW cliff wall.
steps.next_exit: Kill Oak (loot Amulet) → Tag WP by Tree Roots → Poison Roots → Enter The Vaal Ruins
steps.portal_tip: Talk to Eramir in Town for The Apex if you killed all 3 Bandits (+1 Passive Point)!

actions.text: Find central wooden palisade → Kill Oak & take Oak's Amulet
Find Waypoint right next to the Undying Blockage (NW wall)
Poison Tree Roots → Enter The Vaal Ruins

steps.boss_info: Oak: Uses Immortal Call, Enduring Cry, and Leap Slam (Physical).
steps.gem_reward: Deal with the Bandits (Eramir): Grants +1 Passive Skill Point (or Bandit buff).

variants.title: Center Camp / NW Exit
variants.desc: Oak is dead-center; Vaal Ruins exit is always on the NW/NE rock wall.

topology.procedural_note: Oak is always in the center; WP & Vaal Ruins spawn along the NW or NE cliff wall

steps.summary: Navigate corridors to the Ancient Seal → Click Seal to release darkness → Exit to Northern Forest
steps.layout_tell: Procedural indoor maze with high seed variance: work toward the opposite corner from your entrance to find the Ancient Seal (the Northern Forest exit is always right next to the Seal).
steps.next_exit: Break the Ancient Seal → Enter The Northern Forest
steps.portal_tip: Do not backtrack after breaking the Ancient Seal — the exit is always just past it!

actions.text: Follow outer rooms toward the opposite corner from entrance
Click the Ancient Seal ball (triggers screen darkness)
Continue past the Seal into The Northern Forest

steps.boss_info: Ancient Construct & Vaal Fallen: Chaos spitters and elemental Constructs.

variants.title: S-Shape Ruins
variants.desc: Exit and Ancient Seal are always paired together at the end.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural indoor maze: Insufficient fixed layout data — actual layout varies heavily by seed

steps.summary: Hug the coastline/ cliff North-East straight to The Caverns entrance
steps.layout_tell: Linear forest zone: keep moving North-East; skip The Dread Thicket in Act 2.
steps.next_exit: Enter The Caverns at the North-East end
steps.portal_tip: Ignore Dread Thicket in Act 2 (only needed in Act 7)

actions.text: Run North-East along the water/cliff edge
Enter The Caverns at the top-right

variants.title: Linear NE Corridor
variants.desc: Always starts SW and exits NE into The Caverns.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Climb 4 Pyramid levels (each exit is in the opposite/diagonal corner) → Kill Vaal Oversoul
steps.layout_tell: In The Ancient Pyramid Levels 1–3, the stairs up are ALWAYS in one of the 3 corners away from your entry stairs (usually diagonal!).
steps.next_exit: Place The Apex → Kill Vaal Oversoul → Enter City of Sarn (Act 3)
steps.portal_tip: Craft Topaz/Ruby rings if low on Lightning/Fire resist before Vaal Oversoul!

actions.text: Tag Caverns Waypoint → Find stairs into The Ancient Pyramid
Climb 3 Pyramid floors by checking diagonal/adjacent corners
Click Altar with The Apex → Kill Vaal Oversoul → Exit to Act 3

steps.boss_info: Vaal Oversoul: Heavy Lightning Laser (Shock!) + Fire/Physical Slam + Falling Rocks. Never get hit by two consecutive lasers!
steps.gem_reward: Completes Act 2 and opens Act 3 (The City of Sarn).

variants.title: Diagonal Corner Stairs
variants.desc: Each pyramid floor is a square; stairs spawn in the corners.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural dungeon: Caverns & each Pyramid floor place stairs in random outer corners
